description: Wait for subagent runs to settle and collect their results, without polling. Returns settled completions and the still-pending run ids; a run you do not own, or that does not exist, is reported per id instead of failing the call. Use run ids from the delegate_task dispatch response or action='list'.
name: agents_wait

awaitResults.description: Join all listed runs until settlement or cancellation, without polling. Mutually exclusive with timeoutSeconds.

ids.description: Run ids (subagent ids) to wait for, at most 1000.

timeoutSeconds.description: Seconds to wait before returning whatever has settled (default 30). Mutually exclusive with awaitResults.
